Description: Customers report payment failures for approximately 15 minutes. Failures have increased to 18%, and database connections are at 100% utilization.
Payment attempts intermittently time out during the evening checkout peak. The database connection pool shows no idle connections, while the external payment gateway remains reachable.
Error: Timed out waiting 5000 ms for an available database connection.

Description: All payment attempts started failing immediately after a deployment. Application instances are running, but new database connections are rejected.
Error: Database authentication failed for the application user.

Description: Card payments take more than 30 seconds and then fail. Internal database queries complete normally, but calls to the external gateway are slow.
Error: Payment gateway request exceeded the 30000 ms timeout.

Description: Several customers report two charges for one checkout after retrying a request that appeared to time out. Both charge references refer to the same order.
Error: Duplicate capture detected for the same merchant order reference.

Description: One customer cannot pay with a particular card. Other customers and other cards are completing payments normally.
Error: Payment declined by issuing bank: insufficient funds.

Description: Payments fail only in one deployment region. The same checkout succeeds in the other region, and affected instances cannot resolve the gateway hostname.
Error: Temporary failure in name resolution for the payment gateway.

Description: The payment gateway is reachable, but new connections fail during TLS negotiation. Application database health remains normal.
Error: TLS certificate verification failed: certificate has expired.

Description: Payments are accepted by the provider, but orders remain marked as unpaid. Callback deliveries repeatedly receive errors from the application.
Error: Payment callback returned HTTP 500 before updating order status.

Description: Payment failures rise during a promotional campaign. The gateway returns many rate-limit responses, while CPU and database connection usage remain normal.
Error: HTTP 429: gateway request limit exceeded; retry after 30 seconds.

Description: Refund requests are failing, but new payments still succeed. The refund worker cannot write to its local temporary directory.
Error: No space left on device while writing refund batch output.

Description: Checkouts using stored payment methods fail after a configuration update. Newly entered payment methods continue to work.
Error: Stored payment token rejected: token audience does not match merchant configuration.

Description: Only cross-currency checkouts fail. Same-currency payments complete normally, and the application reports failures when requesting exchange-rate data.
Support received three reports that checkout keeps spinning. The affected browser sessions and payment references have not yet been collected.
Payment requests fail intermittently after a database failover. Application logs show connection resets, but newly established connections sometimes succeed.
Error: Connection reset by peer while committing a payment transaction.
